description: The payloads eu-textile@1 refuses or cannot decide. A positive vector is one of the two product documents beside this file, with its `_comment` note members removed, cut into the public and restricted parts the binding names, the public part wrapped in the payload envelope, and the two parts checked together under a passport identifier built from its own GTIN and serial at another host. The test makes every case below from a positive vector by the change the case names, so no altered copy of a product document is stored.

cases.name: notes-kept
cases.description: The document exactly as published. It carries note members that its contexts do not define, and a member no context defines is refused.

cases.name: other-product
cases.description: A document that satisfies every rule of the profile, checked under the passport of another garment.

cases.name: conflicting-serial
cases.description: The stated serial number is another item's.

cases.name: conflicting-gtin
cases.description: The stated GTIN is another product's.

cases.name: granularity-mismatch
cases.description: The document declares the model level under an item identifier. The shapes find it with a SPARQL constraint, and the identity rules find it as well.

cases.name: granularity-product-link
cases.description: The document declares the item level and states a product identifier at model level. Only the SPARQL constraint finds it: the identity rules accept a coarser link to the same product.

cases.name: missing-required-property
cases.description: The location number the shapes require of an economic operator is absent.

cases.name: unlisted-context
cases.description: The document names a context the binding does not list.

cases.name: no-passport-identifier
cases.description: A valid document checked with no passport identifier.

cases.name: engine-outage
cases.description: A valid document checked while the SHACL engine cannot answer.

cases.name: wrong-binding-digest
cases.description: A valid document in an envelope that declares another binding.

cases.name: model-level-document
cases.description: A document about the model: its identifier has no serial, it declares the model level and it states no serial number. The shapes accept it, and the identity rules refuse the model.

cases.name: altered-artefact
cases.description: The background file with one byte changed and its length kept. Registration refuses it and names the file.
